entityDescription:
ARIESPACE is an SME established as the first spin-off company of the University of Naples Federico II. With over 15 years of experience in the fields of Remote Sensing and Geo-information solutions, we provide products, services and consultancy for monitoring agricultural and forest resources based on satellite data. ARIESPACE provides ready-to-use and user-friendly Decision Support Systems (DSS) based on satellite observations, geospatial data and biophysical models. We aim to feel the gap between currently geospatial availability tools and quantitative information needed to people working in the field. One of the main assets of ARIESPACE is the several institutional clients (Water user associations, regional Government) who uses Ariespace geo-solutions based on satellite data to solve their day-by-day managing issues.
ARIESPACE experience has been established in the context of several national (Rural Developing Program) and international projects funded by EU (H2020 COALA as Coordinator, H2020 Landsupport as WP leader of Web platform; H2020 DIANA as WP leader, H2020 Fatima as WP leader, FP7 Sirius as WP leader, FP7 Ceop Aegis, FP6 Pleiades, LIFE+ SoilConsWeb). 
Managerial capabilities: ARIESPACE is organised in four areas: Business development, R&D, Earth Observation and IT. An experienced Project Manager coordinates each project. ARIESPACE has a well-established quality management system, whose compliance with ISO standards (ISO 9001-2015) has been certified by Bureau Veritas. The managing capability has been demonstrated in the several success projects (both research and commercial) and the coordination of H2020 COALA project.
Technical capabilities: ARIESPACE innovative technologies and competitive advantages are based on the combination of competences developed in different international contexts. Collaborations and synergies with several research institutions (including University of Natural Resources and Life Sciences, Vienna -BOKU, University of Castilla La Mancha, Spain, National Research Council and CREA, Italy, University of Naples Federico II, Italy, etc.) have allowed the acquisition and exchange of strong competences in the field of Earth Observation for the spatial analysis and monitoring of agro-forest systems and land resources. Since 2017, as follow up of EU funded project, we have designed and developed Irrisat�, the fist Italian and fully operational EO-based Decision Support System to provide farmers with crop growth information and irrigation advice, involving more than 2000 users in the Campania Region, Italy (about 10.000 plots). In this context, innovative approaches for detecting irrigated areas, irrigation water requirement and nitrogen uptake have been developed. Since 2015, ARIESPACE has expanded the commercial viability of Irrisat including operative services for Water User Association (WUA) and Institutions in charge of irrigation monitoring. The system has been evaluated as fully applicable from National Agricultural Ministry (ministerial decree 31.07.2015), and many Italian WUAs have adopted it for their water accounting tasks. That expertise is also exploited in the COALA project, which aims to export EU expertise in using Satellite data in Australia.

Our Mission and Vision:
We are inspired by unleashing hidden possibilities embedded into location information. This is increasingly important in the world that wants to seek and know more and more.
We want to become a very special provider of location-based solutions in the Eastern Hemisphere for telecom, transport and infrastructure sectors.

Regio has four fields of activity: mapping, geospatial data, geographical information systems (GIS) and mobile positioning.

In GIS software development area our uniqueness is the ability to deliver software together with the data that is fit for the purpose. Our software development is based on Mapinfo, Oracle and proprietary web mapping tools. Our optimization solutions for transport and logistics business offer guaranteed ROI by combining software, data and consultancy together.

In geospatial data area Regio owns and maintains the most detailed geospatial database of Estonia and the Baltic States. The accuracy is up to 1:2 000 in urban and 1:20 000 in rural areas, including building addresses. Streets and roads are connected to logical network, attributed with turn restrictions and other relevant data for logistical analysis.
Regio runs the biggest internet map server in the Baltic States since 1997. In addition to selling access to our own data, Regio renders geospatial data processing services to our clients. Clients are mostly utilities and the public sector.

Mapping unit creates hundreds of maps on demand based on Regio´s own database. Majority of tourist publications, information boards, wall maps etc. feature cartographic products made by Regio. Regio publishes the best selling road atlases for Estonia. We are trained to make maps that are beautiful, readable and accurate at all scales and for all purposes.

The fourth area of activity is location-based services and mobile positioning middleware. Our unique company backround delivers everything needed for launching location-based services, including software, maps and support. Our goal is to help our clients to achieve the record high usage numbers of their services, and in many contries they have done so. Regio has global sales and distribution agreement with Ericsson, our clients are mobile operators in Slovakia, Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates, Romania, India and Estonia.

To sustain the competitive advantage of our products, Regio spends substantial amount of the revenue on R&D. We participate in number of EU FP6 projects.

Regio was founded in 1990 and has 87 employees in 2013. The turnover of Regio was 3,5 MEUR in 2013. Regio is ISO 9001:2000 certified.

entityDescription:
THALES is a world leader group for electronics and a key player in numerous markets such as aerospace, space, ground transportation, digital identity and security, physical and cyber security and defence. Completed in 15 months, the acquisition of Gemalto by Thales for �4.8 billion creates a Group on a new scale and a global leader in digital identity and security employing 80,000 people in 68 different countries. 
The larger Thales will master all the technologies underpinning the critical decision chain for companies, organisations and governments, and will develop secure solutions to address the major challenges faced by our societies, such as unmanned air traffic management, data and network cybersecurity, airport security or financial transaction security.

Research and development (R&D) is at the core of the new Group, with its 3,000 researchers and 28,000 engineers dedicated to R&D. Thales has been developing state-of-the-art technologies to meet the most demanding requirements of customers around the world for decades. Today the Group has become a giant laboratory inventing the world of tomorrow, with a portfolio of 20,500 patents, of which more than 400 new ones were registered in 2018.

THALES participates with Thales Research & Technology France (TRT-fr) and cortAIx Labs, the main multidisciplinary research units of THALES, located on the Campus of Polytechnique in Palaiseau. Through its internal activities and scientific links with industries and universities, either in France or internationally, TRT and cortAIx are participating in the preparation of THALES industrial future in strategic R&D fields. In addition to R&D activities, TRT and cortAIx Labs also provide scientific and technical advice, expertise or services for the company. 
With more than 250 qualified personnel, 13,000 m2 of laboratory space including 1,700 m2 of clean rooms and grey rooms, TRT-France's teams conduct state-of-the-art research in cutting-edge fields such as optics and optoelectronics, quantum technologies for sensing and communication, electronic components for microwave applications, packaging, and materials. The scientific and technical competencies, ranging from materials development to modelling, processing and characterization of components, up to the integration in relevant demonstrators, are available on the site, and allow the complete validation of the technologies studied, before their transfer to the THALES Group's operational units.
CortAIx Labs is the newly created Thales integrated labs for Research, Technology and Innovation on AI for Mission Critical Systems. Located in Palaiseau, it brings together more than 160 researchers - experts, specialists, research engineers, PhD students - dedicated to both AI and a wide range of digital technologies such as cybersecurity, smart connectivity, engineering, computing architectures, quantum algorithmics and neuroscience.
